opentargets.description: A rare variant of malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor composed predominantly or exclusively of epithelioid cells.

opentargets.name: nerve sheath neoplasm
opentargets.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm arising from the perineural cells in the sheaths surrounding the nerves. Representative examples include neurofibroma, schwannoma, and malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor.

opentargets.name: peripheral nervous system neoplasm
opentargets.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm arising from a peripheral nerve or the perineural sheaths.
